paragraphs: R' Menachem bar Avin. He is mentioned in Ruth Rabbah 2:3.[^1]

notes.text: רו״ר is contextually expanded as Ruth Rabbah; פ״ב-ג is read as chapter 2, section 3, rather than a range of chapters 2–3. No edition-specific locus has been independently verified. The abbreviated personal title remains R'.
